answer_1.quote: In this paper, CLAMBER stands as a valuable resource to provide guidance and insight into evaluating LLMs and addressing ambiguous information needs for future improvements.
answer_1.outputs: clarifying questions for ambiguous user queries

answer_2.quote: We utilize BertScore for automated assessment, as lexical matching metrics can not adequately capture clarification abilities.
automatic_metrics: Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic curve (AUROC)

answer_4.quote: To evaluate the effectiveness of clarifying questions produced by LLMs, we engage 3 annotators to conduct a human evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: Each annotator is tasked with evaluating each clarifying question alongside whether the generated question is helpful in resolving query ambiguity (denoted as Help.)
